description: Conditional spin-1 fits to five UVA-ND3 records resampled onto the exact confirmed 500-bin grid.
readout: Constant absorption/dispersion mixture and jointly profiled cubic residual background; evaluate on source frequencies and linearly resample the complete response onto all 500 working bins.
background_convention: b0+b1*t+b2*t^2+b3*t^3, t=(f_MHz-32.7)/0.4. This describes residual mismatch after measured reference subtraction; it is not a substitute for a calibrated circuit model.

center_mhz.source: Visible doublet location; numerical interval, not a field measurement

split_mhz.source: Initial feature spacing; fitted reduced-frequency scale

eta.source: Fitted single-site EFG asymmetry; no empirical horn corrections

P_model.source: Spin-temperature branch-ratio fit; stored acquisition pol and cc are not used

limitations: Hardware tuning/propagation constants are not independently supplied for this setup
Constant complex readout and cubic residual background are conditional approximations
All five records are development examples from one acquisition period, not independent held-out experiments
Interpolation changes resolution and correlates errors; unweighted diagnostic fits do not establish independent-bin noise, covariance or calibrated uncertainty
sampling: Same float64 linear interpolation as examples/uva-nd3.json; source evidence is preserved under provenance/.
